answer: Audits are logged in ridge, queued in ember, and vault publishes the wait time. A farm of 102 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 89 identities per epoch. A farm of 2632 identities would post 921 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
